settings.preferencesDescription: Configure default values for the application.
settings.dataExportDescription: Download all your data as a JSON file.
settings.restoreHint: Restore recreates all data from an export file. It only works on an account that does not contain any data yet. Email account passwords must be re-entered afterwards.
settings.modulesDescription: Choose which modules are shown. Data of disabled modules is kept.

ledger.description: Import bank CSVs, manage ledger accounts, and review transaction history.
ledger.reviewQueueDescription: Work through uncategorized or unconfirmed transactions one by one.
ledger.transactionsNeedReview: Transactions currently need confirmation or categorization.
ledger.categoryTreeDescription: Build and maintain your category tree and keyword match words.
ledger.deleteCategoryConfirm: This will delete the category "{{name}}". Transactions using it become uncategorized and need review again.
ledger.noReviewSelection: Select a transaction from the queue to review it.
ledger.noTransactionsToReview: No transactions need review right now.
ledger.unlinkTransferConfirm: This will remove the internal transfer link so the transaction can be categorized normally. Continue?
ledger.transferCategoryProtection: Internal transfers stay protected from category changes until you explicitly unlink them.
ledger.transferReviewProtection: This transaction is linked as an internal transfer. Unlink it first if you want to categorize it normally.
ledger.unlinkToSeeTransferCandidates: Unlink this transfer to choose a different candidate.

email.description: Configure mailboxes whose order emails are read by the LLM, and link the extracted orders to ledger transactions.
email.folderHint: IMAP folder or Gmail label that contains your order emails, e.g. INBOX or Orders. Only emails in this folder are sent to the LLM.
email.folderMissing: No folder chosen, scans are skipped. Edit the account to choose one.
email.preClassifyHint: One cheap LLM call per batch looks only at sender and subject and skips emails that are clearly not orders. Cheaper, but a missed order is not looked at again.
email.llmRequired: Email orders are extracted with the LLM. Configure the LLM endpoint on the server (LLM_BASE_URL) to scan emails.
email.scanning: Scanning… this can take several minutes
email.scanPartial: The scan was incomplete; skipped emails are retried on the next scan.
email.scanHint: Use the folder scan for normal operation. Upload `.eml` files to process old messages manually. Both need the LLM.
email.ordersDescription: Review extracted orders and verify how they were linked to transactions.
email.reviewMatchDescription: Pick the ledger transaction or split-payment combination that belongs to this extracted email order.
email.candidateWindow: Showing payments booked from {{before}} days before to {{after}} days after the order date.
email.showLaterCharges: Search up to a year later

suggestions.runRemaining_one: {{count}} transaction left, run again for it.
suggestions.runRemaining_other: {{count}} transactions left, run again for them.
suggestions.runNothing: No uncategorized transactions to suggest categories for.
suggestions.runIncomplete: Not every transaction could be processed; the rest is retried on the next run.

failure.not_found: transaction or category no longer exists

recurring.created_one: {{count}} recurring payment proposed as a contract in the inbox.
recurring.created_other: {{count}} recurring payments proposed as contracts in the inbox.
recurring.busy: Recurring payment detection is already running. Try again in a moment.

paperless.title: Paperless-ngx
paperless.settingsDescription: Connect your paperless-ngx instance to search and attach documents across Kontor.
paperless.tokenUnchangedHint: Leave empty to keep the current token
paperless.removeHint: Removing the connection keeps already attached document links.
paperless.searchDescription: Search your paperless archive and attach documents.

pipeline.title: Draft pipeline
pipeline.description: Tag a document with "{{inboxTag}}" in paperless and Kontor proposes a purchase, contract or vehicle cost from its text in your inbox. Accepting a draft replaces the tag with "{{doneTag}}".
pipeline.tagsHint: The inbox tag starts the pipeline. The linked tag marks documents attached to a Kontor entry and is also set when you attach documents manually.
pipeline.runFailed_one: {{count}} document could not be processed and will be retried later
pipeline.runFailed_other: {{count}} documents could not be processed and will be retried later

drafts.title: Inbox
drafts.description: Drafts proposed from your documents or created by agents. Nothing is created until you accept a draft.
drafts.acceptFailed: The entry was created, but the draft could not be accepted: {{message}}
drafts.hintPickType: Choose what this document is, or reject it.
drafts.hintModuleDisabled: This module is disabled. Choose another type or reject the draft.
drafts.hintNoCategories: Create a category in this module first.
drafts.hintPickCategory: Choose a category to accept the draft.
drafts.hintPickVehicle: Choose a vehicle to accept the draft.

notes.unclassified: The document could not be assigned to a type.
notes.empty_content: The document has no text (OCR content is empty).
notes.llm_invalid_output: The AI answer could not be used.
notes.llm_refused: The AI refused to process this document.
notes.llm_truncated: The AI answer was cut off.
notes.llm_request_rejected: The AI service rejected the document, it may be too long.
notes.currency_converted: The amount was converted to EUR at the ECB rate; the original amount is in the comments.
notes.currency_not_converted: The amount is in another currency and could not be converted to EUR; the original amount is in the comments.
notes.recurring_payment: Recurring payment detected in the ledger. Pick a category to create the contract; the payments are linked on accept.
notes.recurring_payment_ended: Recurring payment detected in the ledger; the payments have stopped, so the end date is the last payment. Pick a category to create the contract; the payments are linked on accept.

quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.description: Describe a purchase, contract or vehicle cost in your own words. The AI fills in the form, you check it.
quickAdd.placeholder: e.g. bought winter tires 2026-11-02 at Reifen Müller, €640, Golf
quickAdd.hintCheck: Check the type and category, then continue. You can edit all fields in the next step.
quickAdd.currencyConverted: Converted from {{original}} at the ECB rate of {{date}} (1 {{code}} = {{rate}} EUR). Check the amount, your bank may have charged a different rate.
quickAdd.currencyNotConverted: The amount is {{original}} and could not be converted to EUR. Enter the EUR amount in the next step.

notes.unclassified: The AI could not tell what this is.
notes.llm_invalid_output: The AI answer could not be used.
notes.llm_refused: The AI refused to process this text.
notes.llm_truncated: The AI answer was cut off.
notes.llm_request_rejected: The AI service rejected the text.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: Personal access tokens let agents and scripts use your data, for example an MCP client such as Claude Code or OpenCode. A token only does what its scopes allow.
tokens.createDescription: Choose a name, what the token may do and how long it is valid.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my laptop

scopeHint.read: Read all your data, including exports
scopeHint.drafts: Create and decide drafts in the inbox
scopeHint.links: Link paperless documents and transactions to existing items

scopeDetail.read: Read everything you can see, including the full data export and all modules. Search and list tools in MCP.
scopeDetail.drafts: Create drafts for the inbox (MCP) and edit, accept or reject drafts through the API. Nothing is created without your review in the UI.
scopeDetail.links: Attach paperless documents to existing contracts, purchases, vehicles, costs and transactions, and add references to transactions.

tokens.expiryInvalid: Choose a date in the future
tokens.neverWarning: A token that never expires stays valid until you revoke it. Prefer an expiry date.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{{name}}"? Clients using it lose access immediately.
tokens.revealDescription: Copy the token and store it in your client now.
tokens.revealWarning: This token will not be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
tokens.snippetHint: Replace <your-token> with a token you created above.
tokens.noteRest: Tokens also work against the REST API within their scopes. Token management and the password change always need your login.
tokens.noteRead: A token with the read scope can read all your data, including the full export.
tokens.noteLeak: If a token leaks, revoke it immediately.
